testsuite.name: com.geoknoesis.trustweave.saas.server.services.HolderIdentityServiceTest

testcase.name: a person in another organization is not reachable either()
a credential with no status list is reported as not independently revocable()
an out-of-scope person is indistinguishable from one that does not exist()
a status list failure is counted, not swallowed, and does not stop the retirement()
a device belonging to someone else cannot be retired through this person()
retiring a device revokes the credentials bound to it on the published list()
a person in another trust space is not reachable by guessing their id()
a retired device is not silently brought back to life()
re-presenting from a known device refreshes it rather than duplicating()
credentials in another trust space are untouched()
